title: Sick at Home
text:
Maria has a cold. She has a sore throat and a headache. She stays at home and drinks hot tea. She goes to bed early.

Her brother Ali is sick too. He has a fever. He takes medicine from the doctor. After three days, Ali feels better.

questions.text: Why does Maria stay at home?
How does Ali probably feel after three days?

vocabulary.definition: an illness that makes your nose run and your throat sore
a body temperature that is higher than normal when you are ill
a person who treats sick people
something you take to help you get better when you are ill

paragraph_translations: Maria'nın nezlesi var. Boğazı ağrıyor ve başı da ağrıyor. Evde kalıyor ve sıcak çay içiyor. Erken yatağa gidiyor.
Erkek kardeşi Ali de hasta. Ateşi var. Doktordan ilaç alıyor. Üç gün sonra Ali kendini daha iyi hissediyor.
